I refactored the output side of the algorithm so it stays in domain terms instead of collapsing back into primitives. `[MaxFlowResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/MaxFlowResult.java:1)` now carries the solved `FlowProblem`, the computed flow value, and the residual network as a `FlowNetwork`, with `maxFlow()` and `residualNetwork()` as the primary API.

To support that, `[ResidualNetwork.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/ResidualNetwork.java:38)` now converts itself back into an immutable `FlowNetwork` via `asFlowNetwork()`, and `[FordFulkersonSolver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/FordFulkersonSolver.java:16)` now returns a result built from the original problem plus that residual network. `[FordFulkersonMaxFlow.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/FordFulkersonMaxFlow.java:18)` was updated to use the cleaner `result.maxFlow()` API.

Verification: `javac *.java` succeeded, and `java FordFulkersonMaxFlow` still prints `The maximum possible flow is 23`.
